title: [finding] 32 gates declare only their own artifacts and no scan surface, so path derivation scores them silent for every card — per-gate producer-side remedy, routed by lane
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) from the #14880 flight (PR #15081), which measured the class and — per its brief — reported the members instead of editing any gate. **One consolidated finding for central triage to route by lane**: each gate below belongs to the lane that owns its script; the remedy is per gate and producer-side. Unassigned; `finding` for grading.

## The class, measured at `8af1a6ec` on PR #14866's diff

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives a card's gate families from the paths each gate declares. A gate whose declared literals **all name tracked files** (a baseline, an allowlist, a ledger, a census artifact) and **none a population** (a subtree spelling) is scored `silent` for **every** card, because its declaration describes what it reads, not what it scans. 32 of the 120 SILENT-residue families on that diff are of this class — five of them with the roster sitting inside a directory the diff edits (marked ⛔ in the tool's new block). `check:error-code-provenance` and `check:optional-error-sink` (the card's first two instances) are members.

Since PR #15081 the tool prints these in their own labelled block ("Artifact rosters — N famil(ies) whose `silent` verdict is a fact about a LIST, not about your paths") on every derivation, never counted among the derived families. That is the consumer-side half. This card is the producer-side half.

## Remedy, per gate

Declare the scan surface beside the roster, in the subtree spelling (`packages/**`, `scripts/**`, whatever the gate's own header says it walks). Once a population is declared the gate is MATCHED by path derivation for the cards that touch it, and leaves this block. ⛔ Not a change to the derivation's exclusion of the residue (deliberate, see #14880's triage).
